# WO-119: Regression tests for legacy-builder links to v3-only pages (Copilot pilot)
Status: open (waiting for the owner to enable the Copilot coding agent)
Vendor: copilot
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (PR comments)
Assigned to: GitHub Copilot coding agent (issue labelled vendor:copilot)
Source: in-house SEC-102 fix 99ea32d; first Copilot work order (docs/vendor/COPILOT.md)

## Goal
`tools/build_site.py` (the legacy v2 site builder, still run by the release workflow) now points links to pages that
only the Astro site builds (`v3_only: true` in `site_src/pages.yaml`, such as `developers/`) at the live site
(`site_src/site.yaml` `base_url` + target) instead of failing its link check. Add regression tests for that behaviour.
Test-only: do not change the builder.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New tests in the file below cover: a `{{ url('developers/') }}` link renders as `https://freemyid.org/developers/`
  in the legacy build; a fragment target (`developers/#json`) keeps its fragment; a normal page link (`faq/`) stays
  relative; the legacy build's own link check passes. Use `build_site.main(["--out", <tmp_path>])` or the helpers
  already used in `tests/test_site_build.py`; build into `tmp_path`, never into the repo.
- Read the v3-only page list from `site_src/pages.yaml` rather than hard-coding it, so the tests stay correct when pages move.
- `pytest -q tests/test_site_build_v3_links.py tests/test_site_build.py` and `ruff check tests` pass.
- No network, no new dependencies.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/test_site_build_v3_links.py (new)

## Out of scope / do not touch
tools/build_site.py, site_src/, web/, tests/test_site_build.py and every other existing file.
